observations: Four rectangular batteries are shown, arranged on a concrete surface.
Each battery has a white top cover with visible dirt, stains, and wear.
The sides of the batteries are dark blue with some text and labels, but the text is mostly illegible due to angle and resolution.
Each battery has two terminals on top: one red (positive) and one silver (negative), with black plastic handles attached.
The batteries appear to be of similar size and design, likely deep-cycle or inverter batteries.
There is a watermark 'FRANCOPLUS ELECTRONICS' overlaid on the image.
No visible damage such as cracks, leaks, or bulging is apparent from this angle.
